title: Eldritch Rune

sources.title: Eldritch Rune
markers: '''Eldritch Rune''' is a [[Story Item]] used to open {{CharLink|Shadowheart|Shadowheart's}} [[Mind Flayer Pod]].

summary: Insert into the console beside Shadowheart’s Nautiloid pod to open it.

fields.Acquisition: Loot the dead thrall in the Ceremorphosis Chamber east of the pod.
fields.Use: Insert the rune into the pod console during the prologue.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
